mechanism: Valproic acid may increase dapagliflozin levels through inhibition of glucuronidation and potential UGT1A9 inhibition, while both drugs carry independent metabolic and renal considerations.
action: Monitor blood glucose control and renal function; consider dose adjustment of dapagliflozin if hyperglycemia develops; assess for increased adverse effects of dapagliflozin including genital infections and DKA risk.
